results.title: Job-housing balance and job burnout among migrant workers - Nature
results.content: To examine the effects and mechanisms of the job-housing balance in affordable housing locations on job burnout, this study employs the latest 2018 China Labour Force Dynamic Survey data and in-depth interview data on housing support for migrant workers collected by our research team in 2023. Using data from the China Labour Force Dynamics Survey of 2018 and in-depth interviews with migrant workers in 2023, the study empirically analyses the effects of job-housing balance and housing location on job burnout and its underlying mechanisms. Using labour intensity and work quality as mediators, Table 6 examines the effect of job-housing balanced affordable housing on job burnout. This study uses the 2018 China Labour Force Dynamics Survey (CLDS) dataset and 2023 in-depth interviews with migrant workers in the Pearl River Delta region (conducted by the research team) to analyse how job-housing balanced affordable housing locations impact job burnout.
